description: Delete an event from the user's calendar; it moves to Deleted Items. If the user is the organizer of a meeting, Microsoft sends every attendee a cancellation; if the user is an attendee, it is removed only from their own calendar and the organizer is not told. To cancel with a message to attendees, use cancel_event.

notifyAttendees.description: Has no effect: when the organizer deletes a meeting, Microsoft always sends attendees a cancellation

name: delete_event
